messages:
Nina (CS): quick heads-up 3 customers in onboarding reporting delayed uploads after last night's indexing rollout. need external status + RCA plan.
Omar (CS): are activations blocked or just missing recent docs? list of affected tenants?
Nina (CS): 7 blocked activations, 6 degraded. flagged high-touch: NovaRetail, CourseKit, PaperLoop. full list in ticket.
Hana (Eng): triage: background shard rebalance caused write amplification and retry storms. applied targeted mitigation at 02:12 UTC to reduce dedupe window and resume workers.
Hana (Eng): reingest rate for priority tenants ~550 docs/min. ETA ~60-90 minutes for first three. will update every 30m.
Luis (Product): comms recs: (1) short status email with ETA + incident link, (2) offer 2 platform days credit for blocked activations, (3) schedule a 30m office hour for impacted teams and capture feedback.
Nina (CS): draft external blurb: "We identified delayed document uploads following a scheduled rollout. Engineers implemented a mitigation and reindexing is in progress. Priority activations should be caught up within ~2 hours. We will follow up with a full RCA and host a Q&A session for affected teams."
Omar (CS): add contact path + credit note; example: "Reply to your account team or use this incident page; we will apply a one-time 2-day credit for blocked activations."
Hana (Eng): long-term fixes: add per-tenant queue isolation, cap retry amplification, and schedule rebalance windows off peak. I'll draft infra section for the RCA.
incident-bot: Mitigation v2026.09.01-dedupe-tweak deployed at 1751239800. CI checks passed. :white_check_mark:
Nina (CS): I'll send the status email in 5m and post the sent template here. Omar please own replies for NovaRetail + CourseKit.
Omar (CS): taking NovaRetail. pinging CourseKit lead now.
Luis (Product): scheduling office hour at 15:00 UTC today; will include brief agenda + feedback poll.
Nina (CS): after office hour we'll consolidate feedback into the RCA. tagging follow-ups: @Hana infra postmortem, @Luis customer timeline, @Omar per-tenant reply log. sending email now."
